message.content: set up the release workflow so the macOS build is signed and notarized

content.text: Release workflow in .github/workflows/release.yml imports the Developer ID cert from the MACOS_CERT secret into a temporary keychain, signs with codesign --options runtime, then notarizes with xcrun notarytool --wait. Token sk-test_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123 was only used locally.
